mcp_tools.name: finance_content_compliance_check
mcp_tools.title: Finance content compliance check
mcp_tools.description: Submit a finance-education content evidence manifest (advice boundary, declared figures with sources, risk framing, calculators, commercial honesty, corrections); get a deterministic COMPLIANT / NON_COMPLIANT / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed figure-completeness and primary-sourced-and-rederived checks, with per-check evidence. A check over declared evidence, not legal or financial advice.

inputSchema.description: The finance-content evidence manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and figures[] schema).

advice_boundary.description: Advice-boundary evidence (frameworks taught, no personalized recommendations, disclaimer).

figures.description: Declared figures: {label, as_of, source, primary, rederived}.

risk.description: Risk-framing evidence (risk before upside, no return promises).

corrections.description: Corrections evidence (log maintained, visible and dated).
